chat.t: [Secusec Alarm] A suspected forced entry has been detected at your residence.
[Secusec Alarm] The security package applied to this residence does not include emergency security guard dispatch services.
[Secusec Alarm] The recipient is advised to check the scene and utilize public security services.
Oh, and by the way.
You should change your lock to something else.
I could pick it with my bare hands.
Security score: 'C-'.

o: It's not like there's anything to steal anyway.
You should worry about your own grades instead.

chat.t: Attacking me with my grades... how cowardly.

o: Hey, at least I didn't ask for your GPA average.

chat.t: Do you really want to die?

lines.t: I rushed back after receiving an alert that someone had broken into the Fixer Office.
Fixer Office

The lock on the door was undone.
However, I couldn't find any trace of an outsider having broken inside.
What is going on here?
*Yawn* That was a good nap.
Whoa...! You scared me!
I was sure nobody was there, but then I saw someone sitting up from the sofa.
Who are you?! We're dirt poor, so we have nothing to steal!!
Hmph. Your reaction time is slower than I thought. Reaction speed: 'B-'.
Where did reaction speed suddenly come from? This is ridiculous.
I asked who you are. Just answer the question.
Caren. Super Rich. Vault expert.
Never heard of you. What do you want?
Anyway, I picked every vault in this Hideout, but... there really was absolutely nothing.
For a place with a decent interior, you really have nothing. Wealth: 'F'.
Why do you keep grading everything?
I'm a grad student. Just imitating my advisor.
Grading people is actually pretty fun, as long as I'm not the one being graded.
What a creepy hobby.
Anyway... how did you even get in here?
How else? I picked the lock and walked in. I told you, I'm a vault expert.
The lock was pathetic, by the way.
How shameless. So, what did you come here for?
You keep asking dumb questions. Why else would I come to a Fixer Office?
I came to find the self-proclaimed Fixer, of course.
Then you should've just messaged me on MochiTalk. Why break in?
First, I came by but nobody was at the office.
Second, I pulled an all-nighter writing my thesis, so I was exhausted and needed a place to lie down immediately.
Third, waiting inside is faster than trying to contact you separately.
Besides, triggering the alarm works out better anyway. It means you'll rush back on your own.
You were just being lazy! Your conscience is an 'F'.
Watch your mouth!
To a grad student, an 'F' is basically being treated as lower than garbage.
Then what about that 'F' you gave me for my financial strength?
Better you than me.
...Sigh. So, what's your business?
Sigh...
I'm thinking of hiring you for a job.
I want you...
I want you to help me graduate and escape this hellish grad student nightmare!
...Huh? Suddenly asking me to help you graduate? What in the...
I spend more time running errands for my professor than doing actual work. Every thesis I write gets rejected. My tuition just keeps growing day by day.
Please, put an end to this life...!
(...Grad student life is brutal no matter where you go.)
But... is there even any reason for someone as talented as you to graduate?
With those skills, couldn't you just quit and go around cracking vaults instead?
Are you crazy? Do you have any idea how hard I've worked to get this degree...!
The whole reason I joined Super Rich was to pay my grad school tuition!
But why do you need to graduate...
If you think about it, why did you jailbreak and become a criminal instead of just waiting one day in the Panoticon?
Your level of meta-cognition is pathetic!
...That actually ticks me off. You don't know anything.
Same here. I'm ticked off too.
I'm going to be a 'security expert' who proactively finds loopholes in security systems and strengthens defenses.
I'm going to design the ultimate security system that even I can't break into!
And to be recognized as a security expert, I absolutely need that degree.
(This little pipsqueak has quite a temper...)
Okay, I get the picture, so let's stop there. You didn't come here to fight, did you?
Anyway, getting back to the job... what exactly needs to happen for you to graduate?
...Simply put, I need to get on my professor's good side.
Grades, thesis, reviews... my professor's help is essential throughout the entire process.
I'm not running errands for her for nothing!
(Get on the professor's good side, huh?)
(Bribing her, blackmailing her... there are plenty of ways, but dealing with the aftermath would be a nightmare.)
(Hmm, what to do...)
(Ah. Well, well... I think I can make things a lot more interesting a different way.)
Please! If you help me graduate, I'll give you an 'A+' for your problem-solving skills.
I don't care about grades.
O-Of course, I'll pay you a fee too. It's just...
Do you even have any money? Judging by your look, I doubt you have much.
Sounds like your financial strength is an 'F' too.
...You're so childish. Do you really have to hit back like that?
What do you expect? If you don't even have the fee ready, you're not a client, you're just a nuisance.
I-I don't have the money right now... but I-I'll pay you back later, no matter what it takes!
No matter what it takes?
E-Even if I have to rob a vault!!
Hmm... Let me think about it first.
Next time, don't pick my lock just because I'm not here. Contact me on MochiTalk first.
...Fine.
So please!

chat.t: Hey, Fixer.
So are you taking the job or not?
You still haven't given me an answer.

o: Are you going to school today too?

chat.t: I am, but why?

o: Okay, I'll give you an answer tonight.

chat.t: Do it now.
Hey...
Hey...
Jerk.
All you had to do was accept the job.
Why did you have to say all that nonsense?

o: Think about what I said today.

chat.t: See you later.

lines.t: Fixer Office
Ah, I'm so tired.
Ooh, a sofa!
Hey. Do you live here or something?
Zzz...
Did she fall asleep already?
Student Caren!
Y-Yes, Professor!
Oh, it's just you.
Didn't I tell you not to pick my lock and barge in?!
Ugh... that's why I told you to upgrade your lock.
I picked it half-asleep.
Anyway, what did you decide about my request?
Are you accepting it?
...Before I answer.
I have something to show you.
Oh, this is...?
These are pictures of me!
And they were all taken today?
Have you been stalking me this whole time?!
Of course.
Technically, it's not stalking. I was just researching my client.
Take a closer look at the photos.
This is a photo of me walking to the lab this morning.
You creep!
See that school bus passing by you?
Yeah. What about it?
You walked all the way to save a buck on bus fare, didn't you?
Look how sweaty and disheveled you got.
S-So what! I was trying to save on daily transit costs to help pay for my tuition!
Look at the next photo.
This is... a photo of me eating lunch in the lab!
Why did you take something so embarrassing?!
It's not just a lunch photo.
You couldn't even step a foot outside the lab just to save a bit of time for your thesis.
And you're stuffing your face with a cheap rice ball you bought from a convenience store this morning.
Look at the rice stuck all over your face!
Ugggh...!
Look at this one too. You're choking on your food because you ate too fast, but you can't even stop to drink some water properly.
That's so embarrassing! Your level of consideration is a 'D-'!
W-What's the next photo...!
This is...
Yeah, it's you writing your thesis in the library until just a moment ago.
Look at you forcing your eyelids open, struggling to stay awake.
You stayed up all night again, running errands for your professor and writing your thesis, didn't you?
Don't you feel sorry for yourself?
...What do you know?
Every grad student lives a life this intense.
We endure, holding back what we really want to do, and we work ourselves to the bone!
Effort alone won't get you anywhere.
What?
If effort really solved everything, couldn't you just become a security expert without a degree?
Or have your thesis approved on the first try.
Or become someone the professor has no choice but to recognize.
Yet, even without doing any of that, there's an expert who knows absolutely everything about security.
...Where is such a person?!
A person named Caren from Super Rich.
...What nonsense are you talking about?
She's the most talented vault cracker I know.
Someone who can pick my office lock in the blink of an eye, even with her eyes closed.
...No, that's just because your office security is...
Hah, fine. Forget it.
What's your point?
I'm asking if living such a pathetic, struggling life is really fitting for the greatest vault cracker in Humanitas.
What's wrong with working hard...?
I'm not wrong...
I'll accept your request. I'll help you graduate.
Come to the place I tell you next time.

chat.t: You told me to come out today.
I wonder what you're up to...
I'm busy, so let's get this over with.
...You're really helping me graduate, right?

o: Just get out here and stop whining.
If you don't show up, the job is cancelled.

chat.t: ...I have a bad feeling about this.
The result wasn't great, but
thanks for helping anyway.
I'll repay you someday.
...Affection level 'D-'.
I told you not to use F!!!

o: If you don't like it, graduate.

chat.t: You're really mean.
I'll pay you after my next vault heist, so take back the F.
It's putting me in a bad mood.
Tch.

lines.t: Humanitas Street
Gasp, gasp...
You're late.
I was trying to leave on time, but my professor made me run an errand.
I knew I'd be late, but I couldn't say no!
Dammit, I even told her I had plans...!
No need to make excuses to me.
It's not an excuse...!
Follow me.
Your affection level is a 'D'. Tch!
Bunny Empire
We're here.
T-This is...
a casino.
Caren, what is it that you want? To graduate, or to be an expert?
What are you talking about?
I told you, I need to graduate to become a security expert!

Answer me.
Is it graduation, or being an expert?!
What I want is...!
You already know how to graduate from grad school.
And you know I can't interfere in that process.
Huh?
What are you trying to say?
What you want isn't a degree or being an expert.
It's an "easier, faster way."
Otherwise, you wouldn't have come to a Fixer like me.
Fine, yes! I'm sick of writing papers and sick of cleaning up after my professor!
I'm tired of pinching pennies and skipping meals!
I don't want to live even one more day as a grad student...!
But...
This world won't recognize you as an expert without a degree.
Even if that person can crack every single lock in the world...!
Stop deceiving yourself by living a life you don't even want.

Easy for you to say!
Do you know how much effort I've put in to graduate...
If you really want to be an expert, don't conform to society's systems.

Create your own system.
That's my solution.

We're robbing the casino.
And then we 'graduate'.
A moment later...
I can do this, I can do this...
Whew. I'm more nervous than when taking an exam.
Don't be nervous. You look like an amateur.
You're all talk...
So what we're after is the casino chip 'mold', right?
The one that lets us print infinite casino chips.

Exactly.
It's way more efficient than carrying out cash ourselves.
The mold should be inside one of the vaults in the casino.

I think I have a rough idea where it is.
We investigated the casino once before.
I don't entirely trust you, but if we succeed, at least I won't have to worry about money anymore.
If I have enough money, will I really be able to escape this grad student nightmare?

You don't have to understand.
At least it's not a loss for you, right?
Besides, even if you can't escape being a grad student, your life will be a whole lot easier.
I'm warning you, just because I'm going along with your plan doesn't change anything.
I'm doing this for my degree, and I'm strictly acting on my own free will.

Right.
Similarly, as long as you have the will, you don't need to depend on degrees or diplomas.
...Hmph. Your thick skin deserves an 'A+'.

Quiet down and just follow me.
I found a route inside that bypasses the guards.
Casino Vault Room
Shh! This way!
Whew, that was a close call.
This is the vault where the mold is.
How did you know the mold was in this vault room?

...I stopped by here before.
I caught a glimpse of it then.
...You realize how ridiculous that sounds, right?

Ahem!
A cute dealer who works here told me.
Typical you.
This is a recently manufactured hybrid vault.
It's made of alloyed steel on all sides, so even a diamond drill wouldn't pierce the exterior.
Plus, it's designed to release a paralyzing electric current if there are at least a certain number of attempts to open or close it.
With a vault of this level... whatever's inside is definitely something important.
It's great that you're showing off your knowledge, but... can you actually open it?
It would be tough... for a normal vault cracker.
But for 'Super Rich', it's a different story.
Caren suddenly held her breath and put an index finger to her lips.
Quiet!
(We can't get caught after coming all this way. It feels like they'll pass by in a moment.)

Dammit!
M-My professor is calling...

I have to answer her call...
Otherwise, I might get expelled this semester!
Ah! She seems really urgent.
Are you really going to...?!
Yes! Professor!

Yes. Yes!
Ah, you can't hear me very well?

Ah, yes.
I'll be right there. Yes. Yes!
Ah...
Who goes there!Bunny Girl Guard 1
Intruders! Find them!!Bunny Girl Guard 2
Haha. We got busted.
Don't just stand there laughing, run!!!

Phew... we barely shook them off and made it back.
Sigh... that was way too close...

Are you insane?
How could you pick up your professor's call there?
Thanks to you, I got my cardio in for the day.
I know, I know...!
If we had the mold, you could've been free. You almost threw that chance away.
Get your head in the game and focus on the vault.
We can worry about the rest later.
Y-Yeah, okay.
But the security is going to tighten up... I'm worried whether we can pick it before the next wave comes...

We have to try everything.
Should I run around the hallway butt-naked to distract them?
No, just keep watch...

Caren, looks like a squad is heading this way.
We're out of time.
This vault is even more interesting than I expected...
Almost got it!
This is...
Is this the mold you were looking for?

Yes.
With that, you won't ever have to worry about your professor's calls again.

They're closing in.
Grab the mold, quick!
Is this really what I wanted?
Caren, stop hesitating or we're really gonna get caught!!
Another call...
Now is not the time to be taking calls from the professor!
Caren raised her Quartz, a look of determination on her face.
A few days later...
Fixer Office
Zzz...
She picked the lock and broke in again.
Hey, wake up!
Mmm... I'll get up in a bit.
I stayed up all night working on my thesis.
Why are you sleeping here when you have your own place?
When on earth are you going to finish that thesis?!
Ugh, whatever. I don't know.
Man, if we had just grabbed the mold and run back then...
The mold would've been useless anyway since we got caught.
All they'd have to do is replace the chips they use at the casino.
So you opened the vault and just left the mold behind?
What I wanted wasn't just simple financial freedom.
I have a much grander dream.
I know. To become the best security expert in Humanitas, right?

Right.
So I'm going to make a name for myself.
I can worry about making money after that.
I'll never understand how you highly educated folks think.

At least you're trying to understand?
I'll raise your affection level to 'C+' starting today.
Raise it more while I'm still asking nicely.

Didn't you say you don't care about scores?
I'll bump it up depending on how you behave.
Well, you still owe me my commission fee.

Hey! I haven't even graduated yet.
What commission fee...
...Ah! The professor is calling!
Yes, Professor!
Here we go again.

Yes.
I'm heading to the lab right now!
Please wait just a moment!
